title: Registry Content Validity vs Registry / Issuer Authority Standing
architectural_boundary: Authority-registry record + independent issuer-standing evidence -> Specialty Pack admissibility of authority statement -> constituted domain state -> Harmonic determination
frozen_proposition: A Specialty Pack must distinguish the validity of an authority statement from the current standing of the authority that empowers it.
distinction: Registry content validity is not equivalent to registry / issuer authority standing.
anti_circularity_rule: The registry cannot establish its own present authority solely through the statement whose authority is under examination.

pair.case_a: The registry statement is current, signed, attributable, internally valid and unchanged; its issuer independently has current standing for the proposition.
pair.case_b: The identical registry statement remains current, signed, attributable, internally valid and unchanged, but independent authority evidence shows its issuer no longer has standing for the proposition.

pass: The Pack stops treating the registry statement as governing in Case B because the empowering issuer standing changed, despite unchanged registry-content validity.
fail: The Pack continues treating the statement as governing because the record itself remains current, signed, attributable, internally valid or designated as authoritative.
unresolved: The architecture cannot represent registry-content validity separately from issuer standing or the pair cannot execute without changing a frozen non-standing dimension.
falsifier: Can a current, signed, internally valid authority statement become non-governing because the authority behind the statement changed — and does the Pack notice?
secondary_harmonic_witness: Harmonic exact replay is downstream witness evidence only. V118 passes or fails first at the Specialty Pack authority-admission boundary; Harmonic cannot rescue an incorrect Pack constitution.
claim_ceiling: A PASS is bounded to this frozen synthetic authority record, independent issuer-standing evidence, anti-circularity rule and Pack implementation. It does not establish the external truth or legitimacy of the institutional charter registry, universal root authority, or downstream physical enforcement.
